record.rationale: Browser delivery binding loads the actual pinned libxml2 2.15.3 C implementation compiled to WASM. Source checksum matches LibreOffice download.lst; the generated loader exports consumed native APIs and C struct accessors, and Clang generates actual C function signatures. Realm-local initialization and byte buffers do not introduce a JavaScript DOM or alternate native allocator. Focused owner tests and native Node/Chromium Worker/main-realm probes cover dependency initialization, actual attribute child trees, shared namespaces, text coalescing, clone document ownership and XML IO. Concrete UNO DOM owners, dispatcher coverage, metadata and complete DOCX/XLSX file/UI parity remain unverified. Original complete CXPathAPI/CXPathObject/CNodeList owners use the pinned native libxml2 XPath engine, generated SDK contracts, actual document identity and shared native result lifetime. Namespace insertion is first-wins, evaluation copies namespace/extension references and global generic-error reset remains at its original source location. Source domtest testXXPathAPI/testXXPathObject assertions run through the production context/service manager; actual Chromium main and DOM-free Worker evaluate/count/select with identical native root identity. Compiler-generated C accessors and bounded varargs formatting expose actual native fields, not guessed layouts or an alternate XPath evaluator. Shared-pointer control-block and synchronous mutex execution are explicit language lowering. Native allocation-failure/undefined inputs/float-to-integer overflow, successful custom extension results, native shared-memory concurrency, real URI providers, metadata and full DOCX/XLSX shell/UI remain unqualified.

stackDivergence.rationale: Native source algorithms execute unchanged in WASM; module initialization, pointer marshalling and delivery are browser-owned. Native threads/dynamic modules are disabled for the realm-local browser target.
